set_gpu_ids: set GPU device IDs and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES via Config.set_args
configure_training: configure training hyperparameters like lr, batch size, and epochs in Config
configure_datasets: configure 3D and 2D training datasets and test set in Config
configure_model_architecture: configure ResNet types for body, hand, and transformer modules in Config
configure_output_dirs: configure output directories for models, logs, results, and visualization in Config
